cases.request: Create a personal financial summary utility with income and expense totals, category breakdowns, editable entries, monthly comparison, and clear warning and positive states.
Create a project planner with milestones, prioritized tasks, editable notes, completion actions, progress metrics, and separate overview and detail screens.
Create a workout journal with dated sessions, editable exercise sets, duration and effort summaries, progress history, and accessible completion controls.
Create a study progress utility with subjects, session goals, completed work, upcoming review items, progress metrics, and editable plans.
Create a trip-preparation list with grouped packing items, documents and reservations, completion status, missing-item warnings, and editable checklist entries.
Create a community-event operations utility with volunteer assignments, supply counts, schedule changes, readiness summaries, multiple screens, and a compact status widget.
Create a home-maintenance organizer with recurring tasks, service history, cost records, urgency states, editable details across overview and history screens, and a compact summary surface.
